title.en: Present simple: I walk, he walks
title.sl: Present simple: navade (I walk, he walks)
title.it: Il present simple: le abitudini (I walk, he walks)
title.de: Das present simple: Gewohnheiten (I walk, he walks)

rule.en:
The present simple is for habits, things that happen again and again, and facts: **I walk to school.** **Sheep eat grass.** It often comes with **always**, **often**, **usually**, **sometimes**, **never**, **every day**, **on Sundays**.

The verb is the base form, the same for I, you, we, they: **I walk**, **they walk**. Only **he / she / it** adds **-s**: **Jack walks the dogs.** **Meg runs.**

Spelling: after s, sh, ch, x and o add **-es**: **goes**, **does**, **watches**, **washes**, **fixes**. A consonant + y becomes **-ies**: fly → **flies**, carry → **carries** (but play → **plays**). **have** → **has**.

The negative is **don't** / **doesn't** + the base form, without -s: **I don't know.** **Meg doesn't bark.** (not *doesn't barks*). Questions take do / does the same way (see the page on questions).

English always needs a subject: **It rains a lot here.**

For what is happening right now, use the present continuous: **Meg is running now.**
rule.sl:
*present simple* je sedanjik za navade, za to, kar se ponavlja, in za dejstva: **I walk to school.** (V šolo hodim peš.) **Sheep eat grass.** Pogosto stoji z **always**, **often**, **usually**, **sometimes**, **never**, **every day**, **on Sundays**.

Glagol je v osnovni obliki, enak za I, you, we, they: **I walk**, **they walk**. Samo **he / she / it** doda **-s**: **Jack walks the dogs.** **Meg runs.**

Pravopis: za s, sh, ch, x in o dodamo **-es**: **goes**, **does**, **watches**, **washes**, **fixes**. Soglasnik + y postane **-ies**: fly → **flies**, carry → **carries** (toda play → **plays**). **have** → **has**.

Zanikanje je **don't** / **doesn't** + osnovna oblika, brez -s: **I don't know.** (Ne vem.) **Meg doesn't bark.** (ne *doesn't barks*). Vprašanja gredo prav tako z do / does (glej stran o vprašanjih).

Osebek je vedno zraven, tudi kjer ga slovenščina nima: **It rains a lot here.** (Tu veliko dežuje.)

Slovenščina ima en sedanjik, angleščina dva: za to, kar se dogaja prav zdaj, je *present continuous*: **Meg is running now.**
rule.it:
Il *present simple* è il presente delle abitudini, delle cose che si ripetono e dei fatti: **I walk to school.** (Vado a scuola a piedi.) **Sheep eat grass.** Va spesso con **always**, **often**, **usually**, **sometimes**, **never**, **every day**, **on Sundays**.

Il verbo è nella forma base, uguale per I, you, we, they: **I walk**, **they walk**. Solo **he / she / it** aggiunge **-s**: **Jack walks the dogs.** **Meg runs.**

Ortografia: dopo s, sh, ch, x e o si aggiunge **-es**: **goes**, **does**, **watches**, **washes**, **fixes**. Consonante + y diventa **-ies**: fly → **flies**, carry → **carries** (ma play → **plays**). **have** → **has**.

La negazione è **don't** / **doesn't** + forma base, senza -s: **I don't know.** (Non lo so.) **Meg doesn't bark.** (non *doesn't barks*). Anche le domande si fanno con do / does (vedi la pagina sulle domande).

A differenza dell'italiano, il soggetto non si omette mai: **It rains a lot here.** (Qui piove molto.)

Per ciò che succede proprio adesso c'è il *present continuous*: **Meg is running now.**
rule.de:
Das *present simple* ist die Gegenwart für Gewohnheiten, Wiederholtes und Tatsachen: **I walk to school.** (Ich gehe zu Fuß zur Schule.) **Sheep eat grass.** Oft steht es mit **always**, **often**, **usually**, **sometimes**, **never**, **every day**, **on Sundays**.

Das Verb steht in der Grundform, gleich für I, you, we, they: **I walk**, **they walk**. Nur **he / she / it** bekommt **-s**: **Jack walks the dogs.** **Meg runs.** Viel weniger Endungen als im Deutschen: keine für du, wir, ihr.

Schreibung: nach s, sh, ch, x und o kommt **-es**: **goes**, **does**, **watches**, **washes**, **fixes**. Konsonant + y wird **-ies**: fly → **flies**, carry → **carries** (aber play → **plays**). **have** → **has**.

Die Verneinung ist **don't** / **doesn't** + Grundform, ohne -s: **I don't know.** (Ich weiß es nicht.) **Meg doesn't bark.** (nicht *doesn't barks*). Fragen gehen genauso mit do / does (siehe die Seite über Fragen).

Das Deutsche hat ein Präsens, das Englische zwei: Für das, was gerade jetzt passiert, gibt es das *present continuous*: **Meg is running now.**

examples.sl: Jack vsako jutro pelje Meg na sprehod.
examples.it: Jack porta a spasso Meg ogni mattina.
examples.de: Jack geht jeden Morgen mit Meg spazieren.

note.en: Jack walks: -s for he, she, it.
note.sl: Jack walks: -s pri he, she, it.
note.it: Jack walks: -s con he, she, it.
note.de: Jack walks: -s bei he, she, it.

examples.en: Granny Maggie makes scones every Saturday.
examples.sl: Babica Maggie vsako soboto speče pogačice.
examples.it: Nonna Maggie fa gli scones ogni sabato.
examples.de: Oma Maggie backt jeden Samstag Scones.

examples.en: Auntie Edna listens to the radio every evening.
examples.sl: Teta Edna vsak večer posluša radio.
examples.it: Zia Edna ascolta la radio ogni sera.
examples.de: Tante Edna hört jeden Abend Radio.

examples.en: Meg doesn't bark at the sheep.
examples.de: Meg bellt die Schafe nicht an.

examples.en: The bus goes to Keswick twice a day.
examples.sl: Avtobus vozi v Keswick dvakrat na dan.
examples.it: L'autobus va a Keswick due volte al giorno.
examples.de: Der Bus fährt zweimal am Tag nach Keswick.

note.it: go → goes: dopo o si aggiunge -es.

examples.en: It rains a lot in the Lake District.
examples.it: Nel Distretto dei Laghi piove molto.
examples.de: Im Lake District regnet es viel.

note.en: English needs a subject, even for the weather: it rains.
note.sl: Angleščina potrebuje osebek, tudi pri vremenu: it rains (dežuje).
note.it: L'inglese vuole il soggetto, anche per il tempo: it rains (piove).
note.de: Wie im Deutschen steht ein Subjekt: it rains (es regnet).
